package vm

var extractorSafePoint func(OpCode, *ScopeContext)

// SetExtractorSafePoint installs f. The interpreter calls it on the native
// goroutine between VM steps, before the opcode hook and before the opcode
// changes memory or state. It is never called inside a tracing hook, and only
// traced execution calls it: prefetchers that clear the tracer never do.
func SetExtractorSafePoint(f func(OpCode, *ScopeContext)) { extractorSafePoint = f }
